name: context-engine
description: Context Engine for Claude Code (V1): the agent's Working Context file replaces the conversation at each user-turn boundary. Full Replacement per user turn; Injection within a turn. Opt-in: EXPERIMENTAL: Full Replacement per model step.

mode.title: Delivery mode
mode.description: turn (default): Full Replacement per user turn; Injection within a turn. per-step: EXPERIMENTAL: Full Replacement per model step (gaps: hand-written tool schemas, reduced system prompt, no streaming, blind cost ledger). CONTEXT_ENGINE_CLAUDE_MODE overrides this when set.
